description: This PHP source file contains functions for retrieving and managing related records (such as bugs, cases, notes) in a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment, including session management, user authentication, and related list building.

methods.name: get_bugs_in_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves bug IDs related to contacts, optionally ordered.

methods.name: get_bugs_in_accounts
methods.description: Retrieves bug IDs related to accounts, optionally ordered.

methods.name: get_cases_in_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves case IDs related to contacts, optionally ordered.

methods.name: get_cases_in_accounts
methods.description: Retrieves case IDs related to accounts, optionally ordered.

methods.name: get_notes_in_module
methods.description: Retrieves notes related to a specific module.

methods.name: get_related_in_module
methods.description: Retrieves related records for a given module and related module, with optional ordering and limits.

methods.name: get_accounts_from_contact
methods.description: Retrieves account IDs related to a contact.

methods.name: get_contacts_from_account
methods.description: Retrieves contact IDs related to an account.

methods.name: get_related_list
methods.description: Builds a related list of records based on IDs, query, and filters.

methods.name: build_relationship_tree
methods.description: Builds a relationship tree for a contact, retrieving related accounts and contacts.

methods.name: get_module_in
methods.description: Returns session-stored module IDs as SQL IN clause string.

methods.name: set_module_in
methods.description: Sets session-stored module IDs from a list.

methods.name: login_user
methods.description: Authenticates a user for portal access.
